description: A substructure is elementary if every existential formula true in the ambient structure at parameters from the substructure has an ambient witness in the substructure.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Substructure.isElementary_of_exists.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type u_1}
  [L.Structure M] (S : L.Substructure M)
  (htv :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : L.BoundedFormula Empty (n + 1)) (x : Fin n → ↥S) (a : M),
      φ.Realize default (Fin.snoc (Subtype.val ∘ x) a) → ∃ b, φ.Realize default (Fin.snoc (Subtype.val ∘ x) ↑b)) :
  S.IsElementary
